beats.text: That hot profile photo? It's probably old.
OkCupid compared what users claim with what its data shows.
People are about two inches shorter than they say. And twenty percent poorer.
But the best part: over a third of the hottest photos were at least a year old.
And hot photos were more than twice as likely to be three years old. Twelve percent versus five.
So the better the photo, the older it probably is.

sources: OkCupid (2010), 'The Big Lies People Tell In Online Dating' (OkTrends). ~2 inches shorter; ~20% poorer than stated; over a third of the hottest photos a year old or more; 12% of hot vs 5% of average photos over 3 years old.
